name: lru-cache
title: Implement an LRU cache
prompt:
Implement the `LRUCache` class in `cache.py`:
- `LRUCache(capacity)`: capacity must be an int >= 1, otherwise raise `ValueError`.
- `get(key, default=None)`: return the value (or `default`) and mark the key as most recently used.
- `put(key, value)`: insert or update; updating also marks the key as most recently used.
  When the cache is full, evict the least recently used key.
- `len(cache)` returns the number of stored keys; `key in cache` must work and must NOT change
  the usage order.
